apifyToken.title: Apify API Token
apifyToken.description: Your personal Apify API token. If omitted, the server will read from the APIFY_TOKEN environment variable.

transport.title: MCP Transport Protocol
transport.description: Transport protocol for the MCP server. Use 'stdio' for CLI/desktop agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor) or 'sse' / 'streamable-http' for hosted web services.
enumTitles: Standard I/O (stdio - Default for Claude Desktop & Cursor)

port.title: Server Port
port.description: Port to bind to when running in SSE or HTTP transport modes.

host.title: Server Host
host.description: Host interface to bind to when running in SSE or HTTP transport modes.
